chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Mahboub, from Ali ibn Abi Hamza, from Abu Baseer, who said:

I was sitting with Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) in the mosque when Dawud ibn Ali, Suleiman ibn Khalid, and Abu Ja'far Abdullah ibn Muhammad Abu al-Dawaniq came and sat in a corner of the mosque. It was said to them, 'This is Muhammad ibn Ali sitting here.' So Dawud ibn Ali and Suleiman ibn Khalid stood up and went to him, while Abu al-Dawaniq remained seated in his place until they greeted Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him). Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) said to them, 'What prevented your tyrant from coming to me?' So they excused him in his presence.

At that, Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali (peace be upon him) said, 'By Allah, nights and days will not pass before he rules over the two regions. Then men will strengthen his rule, then the necks of men will be humbled to him, then he will possess a severe dominion.'
Dawud ibn Ali said to him, 'And will our rule be before your rule?' He said, 'Yes, O Dawud! Your rule is before our rule, and your authority is before our authority.'

He said to him, 'May Allah keep you well, is there a time frame for it?' He said, 'Yes, O Dawud. By Allah, the Banu Umayya will not rule for a day except that you will rule for twice as much, and will not rule for a year except that you will rule for twice as much, and the children among you will seize it just as children seize the ball.'

Dawud ibn Ali stood up from the presence of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) rejoicing, intending to inform Abu al-Dawaniq of that. When both he and Suleiman ibn Khalid arose, Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) called from behind him, 'O Suleiman ibn Khalid! The people will not cease from having space in their rule as long as they do not shed unlawful blood from us.' And he gestured with his hand to his chest. 'So if they shed that blood, the inside of the earth will be better for them than its surface, for on that day there will be no helper for them in the earth, nor a forgiver for them in the sky.'

Then Suleiman ibn Khalid went and informed Abu al-Dawaniq. So Abu al-Dawaniq came to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), greeted him, and then informed him of what Dawud ibn Ali and Suleiman ibn Khalid had told him.

He said to him, 'Yes, O Abu Ja'far! Your government is before our government, and your authority is before our authority. Your authority is severe and difficult, there is no ease in it, and it has a long duration. By Allah, the Banu Umayya will not rule for a day except that you will rule for twice as much, and will not rule for a year except that you will rule for twice as much, and the children among you will seize it, in addition to the men, just as children seize the ball. Do you understand?'

Then he said, 'You will remain in the fullness of the rule, prospering in it, as long as you do not shed unlawful blood from us. But if you shed that blood, Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will be wrathful with you, so your kingdom and authority will depart, and your power will depart, and Allah, the Mighty and Majestic, will set over you a slave from among His slaves who is blind, and he is not more blind than the progeny of Abu Sufyan. Your eradication will be by his hands and the hands of his companions.' Then he stopped speaking.

key_terms.جَبَّارَكُمْ: Your tyrant (referring to the Umayyad ruler)
key_terms.دَماً حَرَاماً: Unlawful blood (specifically that of the Imams/Ahl al-Bayt)

ai.seo_question: What is the condition for the end of Umayyad rule according to Imam Muhammad ibn Ali (as)?
ai.summary: This hadith, often cited in discussions of the 'Hadeeth of the Scream' (Sariqa), highlights the political theology of the Imams by contrasting the transient, oppressive rule of the Umayyads with the enduring sovereignty of the Ahl al-Bayt. Imam al-Baqir (AS) provides a specific metric for the Umayyad dynasty's duration—stating they will not rule a single day without the Imams ruling for two—and links the stability of their power to the preservation of the Imams' blood, warning that shedding it would lead to their swift downfall and the rise of a specific avenger.
